repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period with a threshold of 30, causing the action to fire after 30 seconds (29 ticks * 1000ms + 1 tick). The IR requires the action to fire exactly at 30 seconds (300 ticks * 100ms). A 1000 ms wrapper cannot observe the condition dropping and returning between iterations to count the full 30 seconds accurately; it must use a 100 ms wrapper.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period to 100 ms and adjusted the threshold to 301. With a 100 ms wrapper, the first tick counts at t=0. The condition must hold for 300 full intervals (30 seconds). The action fires when the counter reaches 301, ensuring the total elapsed time is exactly 300 * 100ms = 30000ms.
